name: Meshtastic clamshell
about: The Meshtastic pair folding like a laptop (plans/PLAN-HINGED.md): the CardKB under the lower half's top, the Heltec V3's screen in the upper half's, the Grove cable between them through a slot in each hinge wall, the LoRa antenna out of the screen half's far edge. Both lids underneath, so the hinge is a printed one on screws — screw axles that hold the screen at an angle — and magnets keep it closed. Deep enough that the magnets at the front edge clear the CardKB. The Heltec is against the left wall: its USB-C opens there, sunk in the wall's thickness (it ends at the board's edge).
